note: Expands Mermaid source into one native editable DrawingML group (wpg:wgp). Add returns /body/group[N]. The current native compiler supports flowchart/graph TD/TB/LR/RL with ordinary/rounded/ellipse/diamond/hexagon nodes, chained links, pipe labels and dashed links; and sequenceDiagram participants, lifelines, solid/dashed messages and labels. Unsupported Mermaid kinds and advanced directives are intentionally rejected or ignored; C#'s full crossing-reduction/router and browser image renderer remain pending parity work.

src.description: Path to a Mermaid source file when no inline source is supplied.

width.description: Bounding-box width. Aspect ratio is preserved.

height.description: Bounding-box height. Aspect ratio is preserved.
